name: FFS_INVENTORY_HISTORY
description: Contains an inventory modification history to be shown on a corresponding screen.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_INVENTORY.INVENTORY_ID value. The ID of Inventory related to the history log record.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Inventory History, automatically populated by the system.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Time when action was recorded in DB (GMT).

columns.name: OPERATION_TIME
columns.description: Time when operation is performed by user (GMT).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Sequential ID of transaction that defines an order of operations inside of the system.

columns.name: INTERFACE
columns.description: Group of screens or a module the corresponding action has been invoked from.

columns.name: SCREEN_ID
columns.description: ID of the screen the action is performed from (reserved for a future use).

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_USER.USER_ID value. ID of the user the operation is performed by.

columns.name: USER_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_HTTP_USER_AGENT.ID value.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: Identifier of the performed operation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_RESOURCE.RESOURCE_ID value. ID of the resource the inventory record is assigned to.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_ACTIVITY.ACTIVITY_ID value. ID of the activity the inventory is assigned to.

columns.name: POOL
columns.description: Pool that inventory relaets to. Possible values: 'customer', 'install', 'deinstall', 'provider'.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: New values Of affected fields and properties.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: INVENTORY_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.
